headerTitle: Set up your pipeline in minutes with Quartz analytics platform
headerBody: Our powerful analytics platform helps you visualize complex data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

step1.title: Transform your data into visual insights
step1.body: Transform raw data into actionable insights with our intuitive visualization tools. Create beautiful charts and graphs that make complex information easy to understand and share.

step2.title: Manage your projects efficiently
step2.body: Plan, track, and manage your projects with our comprehensive Gantt chart system. Visualize timelines, allocate resources, and keep your team aligned on project milestones.
step2.testimonialQuote: It's the perfect fusion of simplicity and versatility, enabling us to create UIs that are as stunning as they are user-friendly.

step3.title: Create your perfect workspace layout
step3.body: Design your ideal analytics dashboard with our flexible layout options. Arrange components, resize panels, and create personalized views that match your specific workflow needs.
